'''Derek Van Beusekom'''<ref name="dt-21882">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21882 Hidden Peeps], DeckTech (Derek "ust66" Van Beusekom, 4 March 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21882/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21882/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010192627/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21882/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''ust66''') posted a [[Light]] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] list on DeckTech in March 2002.

On 18 May 2003 he won a 15-player [[Death Star II Booster Draft|Death Star II booster draft]] at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, Minnesota, playing Dark Side; he and [[Michael Raveling]] both had four full wins, and he finished ahead of Raveling by one differential point.<ref name="pcf-1291-26390">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
